pageDescription: Manage your data and storage preferences
queryCacheApproximate: About {{size}} of serialized content in this window.

dataDirHelp: Replacing the root activates only the selected directory. Nimi does not copy, merge, delete, or keep using the previous root.
replaceDataRootConfirmBody: Nimi will check this folder first. If it can switch, it will stop running apps and use only "{{target}}" after restart. Existing data in "{{current}}" stays in place.
replaceDataRootProgress: Switching data location: stopping apps, restarting Nimi and checking the new location…
dataRootReplaced: The new data location is active. Check & Sync is refreshing Nimi's local component status.
dataRootUnchanged: This directory is already active. Run Check & Sync to verify it again.
dataRootHandoffIncomplete: The data folder change did not finish. Some apps may have stopped. Check the current data folder and recovery status.
checkSyncModelOfflineConversion: This model's local data needs offline conversion before it can be used. Local models stay limited until then; everything else keeps working.

checkSyncResourceChange.adopted: Re-registered from existing files on disk
checkSyncResourceChange.rebased: Updated path to active data root

clearCacheBody: Clear the cache of content loaded in this window. Your stored messages and files are kept.
sessionBody: Sign out of your account on this device.
dataRootReplacedAuditUnrecorded: The new data folder is active, but this change could not be saved to the audit log. Do not repeat the replacement. Reopen Nimi to continue; contact support if recording keeps failing.
storageReadFailed: Storage estimates could not be read.

separateStorageScopes: These estimates cover separate storage areas and do not represent total Nimi data or overall disk usage.
